cascade_3gear.description: 3-Gear Cascade: Gear 0 (Shape D DNULLMM1nameless lookup, 0 model calls) -> Gear 1 (FormJEPA-v1 k=16 latent beam + rce check) -> Gear 2 (Frontier Proposer fallback on Gear-1 misses)
cascade_3gear.role: Measures marginal call and energy savings when FormJEPA-v1 intercepts structural/syntax/type/method repairs ahead of large autoregressive proposers

form_jepa_v1_k1.description: Single-shot greedy top-1 typed Form edit conditioned on (x, z_hat_y), verified by rce check + obligation preservation

form_jepa_v1_k16.description: Latent-reranked beam of up to 16 distinct candidate Form edits ranked by ||z_hat_y - E_ema(y_cand)||_2^2 before rce check + obligation preservation

context_encoder_E_theta.input: Indentation-aware Form AST S-expression token stream of broken Form x centered on checker diagnostic span + checker diagnostic rule token r

edit_decoder_D_psi.conditioning: Cross-attention and FiLM conditioning on Context Encoder token states H_x and predicted clean Form latent z_hat_y

target_encoder_E_ema.input: Canonical Form AST S-expression token stream of valid Form y (canonicalized via rce fmt and rce fmt nameless)

disjoint_filter_rules: 1. Exclude any file path appearing in the 151-task ladder (65 unique paths) or 40-task H15 residual set (40 unique paths).
2. Exclude any Form sharing a filename stem or numeric-stripped program slug with any evaluation task.
3. Exclude any Form sharing a primary state, actor, or module declaration identifier with any evaluation task.

4. Exclude any Form whose rce fmt nameless SHA-256 digest (shape_hash), canonical rce fmt SHA-256, or raw SHA-256 matches any original, mutant, or HEAD version of the 151 ladder tasks or 40 H15 residual tasks.
data_and_leakage_controls.split_rule: Partition disjoint valid Form shapes strictly by shape_hash (SHA-256 of rce fmt nameless) into train (~80%), synthetic validation (~10%, N=500 defect pairs), and held-out synthetic test (~10%, N=200 defect pairs).
data_and_leakage_controls.target_train_examples: 6,000 to 12,000 checker-verified (broken_form, checker_rule_code, edit_op_and_span, valid_form) tuples

energy_and_telemetry.energy_separation_rule: est_j, reported_j, and measured_j are reported in separate fields and never summed; cloud API server energy remains not_available.
energy_and_telemetry.inference_rapl_host: x86_64 Linux host with world-readable /sys/class/powercap/intel-rapl:0/energy_uj (package-0 and core L2 RAPL reported_j), paired with pre/post idle drift check (Falsifier 6)
energy_and_telemetry.training_host: 32-thread AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 ($BENCH_ROOT), Linux powercap intel-rapl:0 package-0 and core L2 reported_j

evaluation_benchmarks: 1. Held-out disjoint synthetic Form defects (N = 200, unseen shape_hashes): pass@1 (k=1), pass@16 (k=16), latent energy AUROC (H5 diagnostic), and edit-distance energy monotonicity (H11 diagnostic).
2. Frozen 151-task ladder benchmark (H14 plain arm, sha256 6ae255a3...): standalone FormJEPA-v1 (k=1, k=16) and combined deterministic ladder + FormJEPA-v1.

3. Frozen 40 open residual tasks (H15, sha256 3ca3a327...): admitted count under strict C(z)=1 (rce check exit 0 + obligation preservation), restored + behaviour-equal count, reported_j per proposal vs Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B (84.25 J, 27/40) and Claude Opus 5.5 (34/40), and 3-Gear Cascade (Gear 0 DNULLMM1 -> Gear 1 FormJEPA-v1 k=16 -> Gear 2 Frontier).

falsifiers_and_predictions.F1_collapse: Post-training effective rank of z_x or z_y on held-out validation Forms drops below 16 (out of d=256) or mean per-coordinate std drops below 0.25.
falsifiers_and_predictions.F2_leakage: Any training or validation example shares a path, program slug, primary state/actor name, or rce fmt nameless digest with any of the 151 ladder tasks or 40 H15 residual tasks.
falsifiers_and_predictions.F3_vacuous_gate: Any candidate counted as admitted fails rce check exit 0 (including W-UI-1 and W-MUT-1) or deletes mutant obligations.
falsifiers_and_predictions.P1_non_collapse: EMA + VICReg maintains post-training effective rank >= 64 (of d=256) and positive-pair latent cosine similarity > random-pair baseline by at least 0.25.
falsifiers_and_predictions.P2_synthetic_heldout: FormJEPA-v1 k=16 admits >= 50% of the N=200 held-out disjoint synthetic Form defects under rce check.
falsifiers_and_predictions.P3_sub_joule_inference: Per-proposal CPU inference energy (reported_j via L2 RAPL) is < 1.0 J at k=1 and < 5.0 J at k=16 (>15x cheaper per attempt than 84.25 J local 35B MoE generation).
falsifiers_and_predictions.P4_honest_scope_on_h15: A compact ~7M-parameter non-pretrained FormJEPA-v1 repairs structured syntax, method, capability, and single-site guard/type defects on the 40 residual tasks at sub-joule cost, while multi-clause cryptographic stdlib API migrations without pretraining require Gear-2 frontier proposers.
